Frame evidence fixture

  1. Same-site frame (in process).
  2. Cross-site frame (out of process), holding a nested frame back on the first site.
  3. Two owners of the same address, each its own frame.
  4. A srcdoc frame.
  5. An about:blank frame whose document a script writes.
  6. A frame a script navigates to another page after 2 seconds.
  7. A frame a script navigates to the other site after 3 seconds, so its frame is swapped.
  8. A frame removed after 4 seconds.
  9. A sandboxed frame without allow-scripts (its own evidence is not recorded in slice 5).
  10. A lazy frame far below, loaded only when scrolled to.
